benchmark: production Electron renderer, compiled current candidate, isolated disposable TABS_HOME

dataset.seedMethod: Created one real project and thread through the production API, then cloned its validated projection row into the isolated SQLite projection table with unique settled metadata.

methodology.fullOptout: The app's outgoing subscribeShell request was intercepted at the WebSocket boundary and omitOlderSettled removed before the production server received it.
methodology.omitOlderSettled: The app sent the production capability-gated omitOlderSettled option, rendered the initial shell and one 25-thread history page, then exercised the real workspace search and an old-thread route reload.
methodology.actualUiRows: Counts are production WorkspaceShell settled-thread row buttons selected by their accessible row labels after opening the real project and Settled tab. No synthetic test DOM was used.
methodology.observerJsonParseMs: A separately measured JSON.parse of the captured snapshot frame in the renderer; this is an observer decode sample, not a claim about the production decoder duration.
methodology.shellToInitialRowsMs: Elapsed renderer performance.now time from observing the WebSocket snapshot frame to the first actual production Settled row buttons, after opening the project and Settled tab; polling cadence is 100 ms.
methodology.settledViewToRowsMs: Elapsed renderer time from activating the production Settled tab to the actual baseline DOM row count, followed by two animation frames.
methodology.firstOlderPageToRowsMs: For omission, elapsed renderer time from clicking Load older tasks to 50 actual production settled-thread row buttons, followed by two animation frames.
methodology.frameCompression: gzipBytes is offline gzipSync size of the captured UTF-8 JSON envelope. It is not a measured permessage-deflate or on-wire TCP size.
methodology.search: Typed the oldest title into the actual WorkspaceShell Search tasks input; verified the matching task appears after older pages load.
methodology.directLink: Selected that search result, reloaded its environment/thread route, and fetched its production thread projection again.

limitations: Render timings are one run per mode on this machine and include normal renderer scheduling; they are not a statistically sampled performance claim.
The full mode's settledViewToRowsMs measures tab activation through 10,000 actual row buttons. Its snapshotToInitialRowsMs also includes project opening and Settled tab navigation.
The JSON parse duration is a separate observer sample; gzip is offline compression. Neither measures production decoder CPU nor WebSocket wire compression.
Older-history search pagination and direct-route reload were exercised in omission mode. The full mode was measured for shell payload, count query, and rendered rows.
